delivery_id.description: Unique identifier for this credential delivery record

clearance_id.description: Identifier of the REHT GovernanceClearance that authorizes this delivery

clearance_digest.description: Cryptographic digest of the clearance that authorized this delivery

requesting_principal.description: Identity of the principal requesting the credential delivery

requesting_principal_digest.description: Cryptographic digest of the requesting principal's identity

scoped_resource.description: The specific resource to which the delivered credential is scoped

lease_duration_seconds.description: Duration of the credential lease in seconds

revocation_hook.description: URI for revoking this credential delivery if needed

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this delivery becomes valid

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this delivery expires

delivery_digest.description: Cryptographic digest of this complete delivery record
